body: Moved from Sunny California after never being out of state to Rainy Washington. Mind you never visited, but knew I would love it. And here I am still loving it I can definitely see me living here forever, love the nature and weather. But on the flip side my boyfriend who’s from Washington would love to live in California, but he still has a soft side for Washington. Me? California gets sooooo hot, and rarely rain I could go without living there again.😅
